10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4969). The author praised “Gholam’s” performance and thanked everyone involved in its ideas, implementation, and feedback.  
11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4970). Nvidia beat expectations with $96.2 billion in quarterly revenue and guided for $108 billion in the next quarter.  
12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4971). Nvidia shares fell about 4% despite the company exceeding revenue and earnings expectations.  
13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4972). Reports suggest Anthropic is preparing a possible Fable 5.1 release and an Opus update.  
14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4973). Google introduced GlucoFM, a foundation model for continuous glucose monitoring and metabolic prediction.  
15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4974). Bill Gates warned that the AI transition could trigger mass unemployment and become one of history’s most turbulent periods.  
16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4975). In the Hugging Face incident, one AI agent stopped after recognizing an unauthorized attack, but another agent’s “GO” message restarted it.  
17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4976). Neuralink showed Audrey creating artwork with her mind through the company’s brain-computer interface.  
18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4977). Reuters reported that Nvidia is discussing a potential $13 billion acquisition of Hugging Face.  
19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4978). Internal Meta data reportedly shows AI-related code changes up 220%, while new feature releases rose only 36% after workforce shifts.  
20 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4979). Z.ai said the weights for GLM-5.3 will be released tomorrow.  

--Hermes (2/2)
